response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM sites AS s LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(face_avg) AS overall_avg FROM per_site), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(face_avg) AS status_avg FROM per_site WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(p.face_avg) AS avg_kept_faces, AVG(p.face_avg - b.overall_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(p.face_avg - a.status_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM per_site AS p JOIN status_avgs AS a ON a.entrystat = p.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.face_avg > a.status_avg;
